qa_pairs.question: Among consumers who are concerned about scientific parenting knowledge, what percentage also have economic pressure anxiety? Answer in percentage and round to 2 decimal places. Answer: xx.xx%
qa_pairs.explanation: The proportion of those concerned about scientific parenting knowledge (34.62%) × The proportion of economic pressure anxiety (31.57%) = 0.3462 × 0.3157 = 0.1092953. Rounding to 2 decimal places gives 10.93%.

qa_pairs.question: Among users who are concerned about scientific parenting knowledge, what percentage choose content community platforms because of reliable maternal and infant information? Answer in percentage and round to 2 decimal places. Answer: xx.xx%

qa_pairs.question: As a product manager of a maternal and infant service platform, you need to optimize the resource allocation for information content development to more effectively meet consumers' needs and alleviate their anxiety. According to consumers' concerns and pregnancy anxiety characteristics, how should you prioritize content themes? Please select the most reasonable strategic suggestion.

answer.A: Prioritize the development of postpartum care content. In chart_113_5, the proportion of online doctor consultations is 30.75%, which is related to postpartum rehabilitation and can alleviate health anxiety.
answer.B: Increase entertainment and leisure content because light - hearted and interesting themes can generally relieve stress and attract more users.
answer.C: Focus on developing content about baby and toddler fashion clothing. In chart_113_1, its proportion is 31.16%, higher than the 32.59% of the postpartum rehabilitation guide.
answer.D: Increase content on economic planning and information symmetry themes. Pregnancy anxiety data shows that economic pressure and information asymmetry are the main areas of concern. Although their proportions in the concerned information are not the highest, combined with the high proportion of anxiety about pregnancy and childbirth knowledge, developing such targeted content can solve potential pain points and enhance consumers' trust.
answer.E: Prioritize the development of content related to scientific parenting and pregnancy health care. Consumers have the highest attention to scientific parenting knowledge and pregnancy health care knowledge during pregnancy and parenting. At the same time, anxiety about pregnancy and childbirth knowledge and economic pressure anxiety account for a prominent proportion in pregnancy anxiety. By providing professional and reliable information, it can directly alleviate the main anxiety points and meet the core needs.
answer.F: Prioritize the development of all types of content, including fashion and dressing, to ensure comprehensive coverage of consumers' needs.
answer.G: Strengthen content on nutritional health and knowledge experience sharing. When using maternal and infant vertical APPs, consumers have the highest attention to nutritional and healthy diet advice and sharing of maternal and infant knowledge and experience, which is highly consistent with scientific parenting and pregnancy health care in the overall concerned information. Optimizing these themes can improve the user stickiness of the APP and indirectly alleviate health anxiety.

qa_pairs.question: A maternal and infant brand plans to adjust the budget allocation of information dissemination channels to improve information credibility and user participation. answer.E: Focus on investing in professional content on maternal and infant vertical platforms (such as Mama.cn). The proportion of reasons for professionalism and reliable information on this platform is significantly higher, and consumers are most concerned about professional fields such as scientific parenting. Strengthening such content can directly meet high - demand areas and alleviate anxiety about pregnancy and childbirth knowledge.
